    changeBorder()
    Trims the line to the border of whatever beginElement and endElement actually are, so the drawn arc — and its arrowhead — stop at the shape's edge rather than its centre: a simple radius for anything GraphElement.isCircular() reports true (a place, or a stand-in for one, like a port), the rectangle a transition occupies otherwise.

      public void changeBorder()
      Trims the line to the border of whatever beginElement and endElement actually are, so the drawn arc — and its arrowhead — stop at the shape's edge rather than its centre: a simple radius for anything GraphElement.isCircular() reports true (a place, or a stand-in for one, like a port), the rectangle a transition occupies otherwise.
